## Linux AIO 3.0.1

- **KDE Plasma:** changing the mouse cursor works again. The size is set first, and if `plasma-apply-cursortheme` fails, Linux AIO writes the theme itself and tells Plasma about it
- **Title bar button themes:** the buttons stay round in every GTK 4 app. Before, some apps (libadwaita, e.g. Shelly) showed dark ovals without symbols
- New website: https://linux.labtoso.de
